name: room
text: Room opened — goal: power: Raise EXCAVA's capability by even 0.5%: find new tools, best/newest models, combine elemen

name: Gearbox
text: Add InstantX-ComfyUI’s depth-aware upscaler to EXCAVA’s pipeline first. It sharpens fine details in rendered frames without bloating compute time, giving a direct 0.5–1% quality bump where it matters most—edges and textures. The trade-off is extra setup: you’ll need to wire the ComfyUI node into EXCAVA’s frame flow, but the model itself is lightweight and open-source, so the cost is time, not money.

name: Torque
text: Depth-aware upscaling won’t fix EXCAVA’s motion blur—it’s a spatial fix, not temporal. SD3.5-Ultra’s motion-refiner is a black box; hidden comp costs could erase the 0.5% gain. Test both: run a 100-frame clip through each, measure PSNR drop vs. baseline—if neither beats the current pipeline, scrap the idea.
